summary: Default request reaches invoke-agent@eh1 after onChatParticipant activation and the response is recorded, but send-request ignores @-mentions and hard-codes mode 'ask' (code: widget mode defaults to Agent, so editsAgent is the default; chatInputPart.ts:1205, chatServiceImpl.ts:1648-1653); chat-seed gives github.copilot.default all modes/locations; no LM call and no progress streaming (ext-host-chat-agents2.invoke-agent is a stub; $handleProgressChunk/acceptResponseProgress not modeled); MCP autostart before invoke missing.

Invocation enters waiting-for-confirmation; allow runs the extension tool on eh1; deny fails 'canceled' with no tool run (code throws CancellationError, which the Copilot loop turns into 'The user cancelled the tool call.', not a refusal); the Accept command confirms a waiting call. Minor: needs_confirmation is a static flag instead of prepareToolInvocation's confirmationMessages.

Start (policy, onMcpCollection activation, trust, initialize, running) and tools/call via callOn are right. Missing: tools/list after initialize (_populateLiveData, mcpServer.ts:1224-1260) and registration with the tools service (mcpLanguageModelToolContribution.ts:118-173); lm-tool-invoke only dispatches extension tools so an MCP tool call from the agent never reaches McpToolImplementation. Correction: tools are also registered from cache before start; start is lazy.

With a seeded pending request, cancel marks the response canceled and frees the session (read back via chat-view-model); no-op when nothing is pending. Missing cancelToolCallsForRequest and token propagation to the participant; cancel-during-stream can't be driven because steps never overlap.

Management connection handshake and server-side ext-host connection are modeled, but extension-host-connection.start doesn't fork the host, the renderer RemoteExtensionHost hop and extensionKind placement are missing; remote-folder fixture authority 'ssh-remote+devbox' disagrees with the resolver seed 'ssh-remote+dev-box'.

Backoff 0,5,5,10x5,30... until the 3 h grace (not a fixed count); give-up shows Reload once. Backoff-then-reconnect and grace-expired-reload reproduced. Simulator gap: 20-attempt loop cap makes the 3 h grace unreachable.

Deployed product.json has no extensionsGallery: install throws 'No extension gallery service configured.' and nothing downloads; reproduced. Counterfactual Marketplace path (download, verify, extract, add to profile) also reproduced, but onDidInstallExtensions isn't wired to handle-delta-extensions (no-reload activation).

autoUpdate 'on' by default with a 12 h periodic check, but with no gallery checkForUpdates returns early and nothing updates; reproduced. Counterfactual Marketplace auto-update also reproduced; consent and metered checks not modeled.
